name: Tomatoes
description: Perfect for urban gardens, tomatoes thrive in containers and produce abundant fruit.
tips: Stake or cage plants for support. Pinch off suckers for better fruit production.

name: Lettuce
description: Fast-growing and ideal for small spaces. Harvest leaves continuously for fresh salads.
tips: Plant in succession every 2 weeks for continuous harvest. Shade during hot weather.

name: Basil
description: Aromatic herb perfect for windowsills and small containers. Essential for pesto and Italian dishes.
tips: Pinch off flower buds to encourage leaf growth. Harvest regularly to promote bushiness.

name: Carrots
description: Grow in deep containers for straight roots. Choose shorter varieties for limited space.
tips: Thin seedlings to 2-3 inches apart. Keep soil moist for sweet, tender roots.

name: Peppers
description: Bell and hot peppers thrive in warm weather. Compact varieties work well in containers.
tips: Support heavy fruiting plants. Harvest when firm and fully colored.

name: Spinach
description: Nutrient-dense greens that grow quickly in cool weather. Great for smoothies and salads.
tips: Harvest outer leaves first. Bolts in hot weather, so plant early spring or late summer.

name: Mint
description: Vigorous herb perfect for teas and cocktails. Contains growth in pots to prevent spreading.
tips: Prune regularly to control growth. Roots easily in water for propagation.

name: Radishes
description: Fastest-growing vegetable, perfect for impatient gardeners. Crisp and peppery flavor.
tips: Harvest promptly when mature. Plant every 2 weeks for continuous supply.

name: Kale
description: Cold-hardy superfood that improves flavor after frost. Highly productive in containers.
tips: Harvest lower leaves first. Sweetens after cold temperatures.

name: Strawberries
description: Compact plants ideal for hanging baskets. Sweet rewards for patient growers.
tips: Remove runners for better fruit production. Protect from birds with netting.

name: Cilantro
description: Essential herb for Mexican and Asian cuisine. Grows quickly in cool weather.
tips: Plant in succession as it bolts quickly. Use both leaves and seeds (coriander).

name: Green Beans
description: Bush varieties save space. Pole beans climb for vertical gardening in small areas.
tips: Pick regularly to encourage production. Beans fix nitrogen, improving soil health.

name: Parsley
description: Versatile herb for garnish and cooking. Both flat-leaf and curly varieties thrive in pots.
tips: Slow to germinate (soak seeds). Cut outer stems first for continuous harvest.

name: Cucumbers
description: Vining plants perfect for vertical growing. Compact bush varieties available for containers.
tips: Trellis for space-saving. Harvest when 6-8 inches for best flavor.

name: Arugula
description: Peppery salad green that grows quickly. Perfect for succession planting in small spaces.
tips: Harvest young leaves for milder flavor. Bolts in heat, plant in cool seasons.

name: Chives
description: Perennial herb with mild onion flavor. Edible purple flowers attract pollinators.
tips: Divide clumps every 2-3 years. Cut to 2 inches above soil for regrowth.

name: Swiss Chard
description: Colorful stems add visual interest. Heat-tolerant and productive throughout summer.
tips: Harvest outer leaves. Rainbow varieties are ornamental and edible.

name: Thyme
description: Low-maintenance Mediterranean herb. Drought-tolerant once established.
tips: Trim after flowering. Dry for long-term storage. Pairs well with rosemary.
